$comment: Performance budgets checked by scripts/ci/check_perf_budgets.py after `make ios-perf` (perf-app-runtime.md §5.2 and §6). Each gate is the median of the XCTest iterations of a Release build on the CI simulator. XcodeGen regenerates the .xcodeproj, so Xcode's own baselines cannot persist; budgets live here instead. The simulator-to-A13 speed factor is UNVERIFIED until the owner's device calibration (decision D-P3), so each CI gate sits below its device target by the stated margin. `test` matches a substring of the xcresult test identifier; `metric` matches a metric's identifier or display name; `median_max` is in the metric's own unit.

budgets.name: Sample entry to full projection (flagship)
budgets.device_target: tap to full dashboard <= 300 ms on the oldest supported device
budgets.source: perf-app-runtime.md §5.2: CI gate <= 150 ms, a 2x margin under the device target
